hypothesis: W-R52 improves mean synthetic accuracy without meaningfully improving worst-source reliability. A closed-form, order-invariant 16-parameter ridge least-squares relative-pair readout may generalize more consistently across three training cohorts than fixed 32-epoch full-batch perceptron, at a different computational cost and objective.
freeze: Three new development cohorts3680..3695,3712..3727,3744..3759 and one untouched sealed heldout3808..3855 (48 seeds), all synthetic 3 generators/2 swap sites, positive-first and negative-first balanced, identity/XOR55. Each cohort has two frozen signed 1728-example training distributions: affine_prior only and balanced across 3 families (576 each). For each fit two models: W-R52 exact32-epoch full batch perceptron and closed-form ridge using normalized XtX/n and Xty/n with fixed lambda1.0, deterministic Gauss-Jordan partial pivot solver, no intercept, 16 weights, no grid/search/holdout-guided tuning. Total12 models, same training samples within each paired treatment but different optimizer and compute.
primary: RIDGE_WORST_FAMILY_GAIN iff in ALL 3 dev cohorts, mixed_ridge achieves heldout worst generator accuracy at least +0.03 over mixed_batch, overall accuracy>=0.55 and no source-family decrease of more than 0.05; PARTIAL_RIDGE_GAIN iff at least two of three cohorts improve min-family accuracy >=0.02; NO_GAIN otherwise. Do not promote model from posthoc best cohort.
controls: Use exact W-R52 development generation/feature extractor and 16-float zero-intercept parameterization; ridge has distinct loss and solver FLOPs, not equal-compute despite equal data and parameter counts.
Training models are frozen before new sealed data is processed; no dev-scoring-based selection or heldout-based hyperparameter adaptation.
Unit tests require solver residual max absolute <=1e-7 and exact dual presentation, XO55 invariance and same per-seed source group scoring.
Full first-use evidence artifact, one full Go regression/build, no accepted refs, FSA claims, controller or production mutation.
claim_limit: Synthetic supervised relative-pair least-squares regression in fixed-width feature space, not a general cognition or physical-world training proof.
